Binta once spearheaded a critical API security audit for a high-profile client, identifying a vulnerability in their authentication flow that could have exposed user data. She designed a custom test suite using Python and GitLab CI, integrating Selenium to simulate real-world attack vectors. Her work not only flagged the issue but also streamlined the team’s testing process, cutting regression cycles by 30%.  

We’ve collaborated occasionally on cybersecurity projects, mostly via Slack and shared docs. As a peer, I’ve observed her consistently deliver precise, actionable insights. She’s the kind of engineer who’ll spend 20 minutes debugging a flaky test instead of rushing to fix it.  

Binta’s strength lies in her ability to bridge technical rigor with practical impact. She owns API testing workflows, often refining them to handle edge cases others overlook. Her security testing approach is methodical—she’ll dig into logs, replay attacks, and push teams to think beyond standard scenarios. She’s also a quiet mentor, helping junior engineers grasp the nuances of test automation without sounding preachy.  

In short, she’s a reliable, detail-oriented problem-solver who elevates the quality of everything she touches. Her work has directly improved system reliability and reduced critical bugs in production.  

Feel free to reach out if you need further details.
